central_topic: Citation gaps in a paper on minimal removal sets (verified by exact Bradley-Terry refit) that flip adjacent-pair rankings of pairwise-comparison leaderboards: the Chatbot Arena / MT-Bench data and platforms, influence-function and case-deletion diagnostics behind the first-order removal ranking, and manipulation or corruption of crowd-vote and pairwise-comparison rankings.
core_methods: first-order (one-step Newton) influence of deleting a row on the Bradley-Terry score gap, with leave-one-out leverage correction
case-deletion diagnostics (Cook's distance style) for logistic-type likelihoods
comparators: adversarial manipulation and vote rigging of crowd-vote leaderboards
robustness of pairwise-comparison rankings to corrupted comparisons
result_driven_themes: small removal fractions flip crowd-vote leaderboard ranks, motivating positioning against deliberate manipulation work

queries.query: Chatbot Arena open platform for evaluating LLMs by human preference
queries.rationale: Target arena-leaderboard-context (Introduction, Data): the opening claim that Bradley-Terry leaderboards are used to choose and announce models, and the Arena 55k/140k data, have no platform citation.

queries.query: Judging LLM-as-a-judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena human pairwise judgments
queries.rationale: Target arena-leaderboard-context (Data): the MT-Bench human expert judgments and the Arena human-preference data release are used without citing the dataset paper.

queries.query: Understanding black-box predictions via influence functions
queries.rationale: Target influence-deletion-method (Problem Setup and Method): the Newton-step influence formula for deleting row i is the core of the studied configuration and currently cites only Broderick et al.

queries.query: Cook's distance case deletion diagnostics one-step approximation logistic regression
queries.rationale: Target influence-deletion-method: the leverage-corrected leave-one-out approximation and the B2 influence-only comparator follow classical deletion diagnostics for likelihood models, which the draft states without support.

queries.query: adversarial vote manipulation of LLM arena leaderboard rankings
queries.rationale: Target manipulation-positioning (Related Work, Introduction, Discussion): the removal budget is motivated through deliberate action and rigging, and the draft currently disclaims positioning against this work.

queries.query: robustness of rankings from pairwise comparisons to adversarial or corrupted comparisons
queries.rationale: Target manipulation-positioning: gives one or two general comparator citations on how few corrupted comparisons change a pairwise-derived ranking, replacing the Scope-of-the-bibliography disclaimer.

forbidden_query_patterns: chronology of cycles, attempts or search history
internal score names such as combined_score or rubric
titles, authors or results of the withheld published paper on this research question, or pages citing it
unrelated LLM architecture or training queries
further Bradley-Terry extensions, existence/consistency or uncertainty theory already covered by the bibliography
